videos.headline: The Stanley cup Short has 1,138 views in two days, by far the channel's best, but Analytics has no data on it yet.

why.text: 1,138 public views 2.2 days after publishing; the channel's other three Shorts have 12, 46 and 34.
Analytics has 0 views for it so far, so there is no stayed-to-watch figure or drop point yet; too few Shorts for a channel median.

videos.next: Make another 'a boring product went viral overnight' Short with the sales figure held for the payoff, and check its drops once Analytics catches up.

videos.headline: The Nike swoosh Short has 12 views in two days: the feed barely showed it.

why.text: 12 public views 2.0 days after publishing, against 1,138 for the Stanley Short a few hours before it.
Analytics has 0 views for it, so there is no stayed-to-watch figure or drop point; too few Shorts for a channel median.

videos.next: Too few videos to say why; keep the logo-origin story out of the next two Shorts and compare once Analytics has data.
